notes.title: Version 1.2 is released
notes.notes:
We have released one of our very updated versions of the Game Agent Roy - Secure The Temple. 

What we have updated:
[olist]
 Avtar change option: there are 5 different avatars to change
 Scoreboard: Scoreboard will store the top score and the last 50 scores.
 Setting: Through setting one can change mouse sensitivity, Display and Sound Quality. 
[/olist]

Moreover, we have added a new video to show you the next mission which is coming on mid of February and will update automatically without any extra cost.
